description: Implement the HTTP version of the custom Netmaker GUI page: add client wiring, navigation entry, route, and full NetmakerPage.tsx with Networks, Hosts, Events, and CLI Console tabs.

Added { id: \"netmaker\", label: \"Netmaker\", route: \"/netmaker\", icon: \"Radio\", section: \"Infrastructure\", order: 55 } to manifest.ts between btrfs(50) and data-stores(60).
Added lazy(() => import('./pages/NetmakerPage')) and <Route path=\"/netmaker\" element={<NetmakerPage />} /> to App.tsx, between btrfs and data-stores.

Created NetmakerPage.tsx (~900 lines) with full implementation: Networks tab (network cards + node table + node detail panel), Hosts tab (host inventory table), Events tab (live streaming events from streamEvents RPC), CLI Console tab (command picker + parameter inputs + output history).
